item.title: Ask HN: Is anyone else struggling with AI wealth FOMO?
item.description:
I’ve lately been struggling with enjoying a perfectly good life when I’m constantly reminded that other people are experiencing extraordinary financial success.

And that success feels…strange? I don’t know how to put words to it. Like the monetary values associated are untethered to delivering value?
